summary.text: William Slater is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 35, where he has served since November 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Slater is on the ballot with Phil Barnes.

paragraphs.text: William Slater earned a B.S. in education from Hyles-Anderson College, an M.Ed. in educational leadership from the University of South Florida, and a J.D. from Nashville School of Law.
His career experience includes working as a dean of Welch College.
Slater has served as president of Improve Hendersonville, advisory chair of Living Sent Ministries, and board chair of Restoring Hope Christian Academy.
Slater won the District 35 seat in the November 8, 2022 general election, succeeding Jerry Sexton, and was re-elected in November 2024.
In the 2023–2024 session he was vice chair of the Education Administration Committee and a member of the Local Government Committee.
